subject: SIG Assessment: control mapping & artifact timeline for Bluecrest Capital
messages:
From: Sarah Liang <sarah.liang@bluecrest.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>; procurement@bluecrest.com
Cc: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@bluecrest.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: SIG assessment & artifact request — Bluecrest / Redwood

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for taking this on. We're running a SIG assessment and need a control-level mapping and supporting artifacts to satisfy our internal audit. Specifically Bluecrest is requesting:

- A completed SIG questionnaire (we've attached the baseline) with control-by-control evidence references
- Sample artifacts for key controls: KMS/key rotation proof, access review logs, telemetry sampling for inference requests
- A short explanation of your private deployment options (VPC/on-prem) and any sample SOC 2 scope language
- Target delivery timeline (we're hoping to get the packet within two weeks)

Can you confirm who on your side will own the evidence collection and whether Redwood can provide a consolidated evidence bundle (PDF + index)? We're also interested in any short statement on key rotation cadence and an example artifact to show auditors.

Happy to schedule a 30-min call this week to walk through the asks and mutual action plan.

Thanks,
Sarah Liang
Senior Procurement Manager
Bluecrest Capital

Attachments referenced: Bluecrest_SIG_template_v2.docx (we will send separately)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liang <sarah.liang@bluecrest.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG assessment & artifact request — Bluecrest / Redwood

Hi Sarah — great to meet you over email. Copying Jonas (platform security) and Karthik (assurance operations) so we can triage artifacts.

Short answers up front:
- We will provide a completed SIG (control-level) with an evidence index and supporting artifacts.
- We can produce a consolidated evidence bundle (PDF) plus an Excel index that maps each SIG control to artifact filenames and collection notes.
- KMS/key rotation cadence: 90 days for asymmetric signing keys; 12-month rotation for service-layer symmetric keys by default (exceptions documented). We will include a rotation statement and sample rotation logs.

Next steps / proposed timeline: 
1) We attach our initial index (redwood_sig_index_v1.xlsx) and an evidence manifest (redwood_evidence_manifest_v1.pdf) for your intake.
2) Please confirm priority controls (if you need SOC 2 anchor controls first, let us know).
3) We schedule a 30-min intake call to lock the mutual action plan. Proposed times: Tue 11/3 09:30–11:00 PT or Wed 11/4 13:00–15:00 PT.

We will own the artifact assembly. Jonas will pull rotation and telemetry samples; Karthik will coordinate packaging and redaction. We'll deliver a zip with a searchable PDF bundle and an Excel crosswalk.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: redwood_sig_index_v1.xlsx; redwood_evidence_manifest_v1.pdf
From: Sarah Liang <sarah.liang@bluecrest.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@bluecrest.com>, procurement@bluecrest.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG assessment & artifact request — Bluecrest / Redwood

Evelyn — thanks for the quick reply and the index. A couple of clarifying items before we set the call:

- For the KMS rotation samples: can you provide proof that rotations are automated vs manual, and include the last three rotation events (anonymized is fine) with timestamps and the principal that executed them? Our auditors want evidence of automation and proof of cadence.
- For telemetry: a sanitized sample CSV that shows token-level latency/route mapping for a 24-hour window would be ideal.
- On private deployments: we mainly want the sample SOC 2 scope language that states what remains in-scope when a customer deploys to VPC (esp. telemetry and logs).

If you can attach one example artifact for each bullet to the intake email that'd help speed things up. Otherwise we can discuss on the call.

Happy to do Tue 11/3 09:30 PT.

Best,
Sarah
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liang <sarah.liang@bluecrest.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG assessment & artifact request — Bluecrest / Redwood

Hi Sarah / Evelyn — Jonas here. Short technical notes and what I'll attach for the intake bundle:

- KMS rotation: rotations are managed by our key-management pipeline (KMP) which enforces rotation windows via IAM policies and automated rotation jobs. I'll include a rotation statement (kms_rotation_statement.pdf) and three recent rotation events (events are redacted for principal IDs but include timestamps and key identifiers). The rotation job is run by an automated workflow (cron + orchestration), not manual intervention.

- Telemetry sample: attached a sanitized 24-hour telemetry manifest (telemetry_sample_manifest.csv) that shows request_id, route, model_variant, latency_ms bucket, and region tag. All PII and customer identifiers are redacted; token-level metrics are aggregated where needed.

- Private deployment SOC2 scope language: we maintain that customer data and model artifacts remain in-customer VPC; Redwood's control footprint in Private mode is limited to the control plane access and (optional) managed services. Karthik will append the legal-acceptable scope language to the evidence bundle.

I'll bring the attachments to the intake call and can walk through the samples.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Principal Platform Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: kms_rotation_statement.pdf; telemetry_sample_manifest.csv
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liang <sarah.liang@bluecrest.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 16:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG assessment & artifact request — Bluecrest / Redwood

Hi Sarah — following up after our intake call. Quick status and delivery plan: 

- Action items owned by Redwood: assemble consolidated evidence bundle (Evelyn / Karthik), produce rotation statement + event extracts (Jonas), redact and create index (Karthik).
- Delivery date: we will deliver the searchable PDF bundle + Excel crosswalk by Thu 11/12 EOD PT (ten business days from today). If you need an accelerated delivery for SOC 2 anchor controls, let us know and we can prioritize specific artifacts.
- Links: I've posted the working packet here: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-id-redwood/Bluecrest-SIG-Packet ; HubSpot record HSP-9231 will track the activity.

Attachments we'll include in the final package: redwood_sig_index_v1.xlsx, redwood_evidence_manifest_v1.pdf, kms_rotation_statement.pdf, telemetry_sample_manifest.csv, mutual_action_plan_template.docx.

If you want a signed attestation covering rotation cadence and evidence authenticity, we can include a short sign-off from our Head of Security as an extra artifact.

Thanks everyone — we'll ping when the bundle is uploaded.

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
